title: Rust FragmentReceiver accepts unauthenticated bytes outside Link policy
description: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs FragmentReceiver remains a bare byte/Fragment state machine with no LinkLayer AuthenticatedFrame evidence, current authenticated peer permit, (local identity, remote signer, Rule ID) session key, replay counter binding, or tombstone. Unauthenticated bytes can allocate/reset/abort receive state and produce responses, contradicting the authenticated fragmentation requirements in spec/03-adaptation.md. Gate all production receiver transitions on exact current Link-owned evidence and bounded session ownership, with replay/rekey/reboot/foreign-signer/wrong-target tests and shared vectors.
notes: Final robustness review confirms public FragmentReceiver::new/receive_bytes/receive still offers an unauthenticated state-mutating/response-producing network-facing path beside AuthenticatedFragmentReceiver. Seal or feature-gate the raw receiver API.
